Reforms across the startup ecosystem, compliance reduction, sectoral regulation, foreign direct investment and single-window clearances have reduced the regulatory burden on businesses and delivered…
items.title: DPIIT Advances Trust-Based Governance Through Startup Support, Regulatory Reforms and Digital Single-Window Clearances

items.summary: The Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India, has launched the 6th Edition of the National Startup Awards (NSA 6.0) under the Startup India initiative to recognise innovation and entrepreneurship and strengthen India’s startup ecosystem.
items.title: DPIIT Launches 6th Edition of National Startup Awards to Recognise Innovation and Entrepreneurship
